title: eludite.debug.output input
description: What the program printed since the last call: read the session's output by cursor, forward from `since`, at most `max_lines` lines, optionally only lines matching `pattern`. Keep `next` and pass it as `since` next time to read only new lines; `dropped` says how many lines the 10,000-line ring lost before you read them. Works in any mode (also after the session ends, until the next one starts), runs no debuggee code and costs nothing in the adapter. The Output window's Debug source shows the same lines to the person.

source.description: `program` (default): what the debuggee wrote to stdout and stderr. `debug`: the debugger's own messages (starting, exceptions thrown, exit codes, evaluations in the Output window). `adapter`: the debug adapter's stderr and its console messages.

since.description: A cursor: list lines from this sequence number on (`next` of the previous answer). Default 0, the session's first line.

max_lines.description: The most lines listed (default 20, at most 1000).

pattern.description: Only lines containing this text, or matching a regular expression written `/regex/`.
